Stone

Collect the loose stone available on land you own first. A reliable repeatable source after that supply is exhausted has not yet been verified.

  • Current-build players report gathering loose stone from ranch land and eventually exhausting the visible supply. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Crime system (current-build stone reports) · August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Taking stone from land you do not own can be treated as theft and trigger fines or jail; neighboring plots are not a safe free supply. Single-source lead

    Source: Steam thread: Crime system (current-build stone reports) · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Reliable repeatable Stone supply is still being verified. Mines are not available in the reviewed Early Access build. Official

    Source: Steam thread: Questions about the game (official moderator answer) · Build: 0.8.10.x

Wood Log

Wood Logs are the base material for early construction and the input used by the community charcoal method.

  • Current community reports obtain Wood Logs by cutting trees; the retained reports do not establish tree respawn timing or ownership rules. Community-confirmed

    Source: August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Launch-build footage shows a Red Tent recipe requiring 10 Wood Logs and 8 Stone; it does not prove other recipe costs. Video-observed

    Source: Games Station gameplay footage: Red Tent recipe at 71:40 · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.455

Hay

Hay is chicken feed. The public current-build gathering route is still based on a single traceable player report.

  • An official moderator answer identifies hay as chicken feed; place it in the interior trough or load a connected silo for automation. Official

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken Feed (official moderator answer) · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • One current-build report gets hay by cutting bushes or searching crates and barrels on NPC farms. Treat this as a route to test, not a guaranteed drop table. Single-source lead

    Source: Steam thread: where can I find hay (single current-build report) · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x

Charcoal

A community lead suggests burning Wood Logs and extinguishing the fire before collecting Charcoal. Current-build steps, yield and fire behaviour still need a direct screenshot or video.

  • A community lead suggests placing or cutting Wood Logs, igniting them, waiting for a material change, then using a fire extinguisher before collecting Charcoal. The retained scan has no direct post URL, so this remains a route to test. Single-source lead

    Source: August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The moderator separately identifies the fire extinguisher as the intended way to put out fires. The retained evidence does not lock down one keyboard control or an exact burn timer. Official · historical

    Source: Steam thread: Fundamental Issues (moderator fire-extinguisher clarification) · Build: pre-EA-2025

Zirconite

Buy Zirconite for now. The official moderator says purchasing is the only current route until mines are implemented.

  • The official moderator says buying Zirconite is the only current option until mines are implemented; do not search for a wild ore route in this build. Official

    Source: Steam thread: Questions about the game (official moderator answer) · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Multiple current community answers identify Meriam at City Hall as the seller. The retained evidence does not support publishing a stable current price. Community-confirmed

    Source: August 2026 community scan: charcoal, zirconite and stone threads · original URL not retained · Build: 0.8.10.x
